architectural_planes.plane: 1. Signals, Sensors, Actuators & Unified Data/Context Plane
architectural_planes.products: ISOC (Integrated SOC in Microsoft Defender) + Microsoft Sentinel + Defender XDR + Security Exposure Management
architectural_planes.status_nov_2026: Core GA (Nov 17, 2026); Full SIEM breadth & selected data features in Preview
architectural_planes.key_capabilities: Unifies Sentinel SIEM + Defender XDR in one Defender portal (>165T daily signals, >500 connectors). Core GA: case management, playbooks, workbooks, UEBA, workspace creation, 3P ingestion, built-in data lake, $2.40/GB ingestion, opt-in for existing Sentinel customers (M365 E5/E7/Defender Suite). Preview: 90-day built-in Defender retention, ingest-time normalization, Content Hub, detections-as-code, automation audit logs, Vulnerability Shielding.
architectural_planes.role_vs_others: Shared operational surface, context graph and actuator plane that feeds Perception and Security Copilot.

architectural_planes.status_nov_2026: Platform GA (Nov 17, 2026); mixed GA/Preview across individual agents & playbooks
architectural_planes.key_capabilities: Closed-loop Red, Blue, and Green team agents coordinated via Playbooks or natural-language Chat, with dynamic per-job model routing, shared Security Context, human-in-the-loop approval gates, cost estimator/dashboards, and API/MCP integration (Preview) with external SIEM/SOAR/ITSM and 3P signals (AWS, Okta, Salesforce).
architectural_planes.role_vs_others: Orchestrates teams of specialized agents end-to-end toward measurable security outcomes (unlike single-task assistants).

architectural_planes.products: Microsoft Security Copilot (+15 Microsoft-built agents + 30+ partner agents in Security Store)
architectural_planes.status_nov_2026: GA platform + M365 E5/E7 inclusion rollout (started Nov 18, 2025); mix of GA & Preview agents
architectural_planes.key_capabilities: Interactive analyst copilot + task-specific autonomous/scheduled agents embedded in Defender, Entra, Intune, Purview, and Sentinel. Uses SCUs and supports dedicated Entra Agent ID.
architectural_planes.role_vs_others: Assists human practitioners inline and automates domain-specific operational queues across SecOps, IAM, Endpoint IT, and Data Security.

architectural_planes.plane: 4. Deterministic Enterprise SOAR & Hybrid Multi-SIEM Integration Plane
architectural_planes.products: Azure Logic Apps (Sentinel/Defender Playbooks + Custom Connectors + MCP)
architectural_planes.key_capabilities: 1,400+ enterprise/ITSM/network/on-prem connectors (Data Gateway), deterministic approvals, state persistence, RBAC/Managed Identity, low-cost consumption/Standard tiers, seamless coexistence with Splunk on-prem, ServiceNow, Jira, firewalls, and Perception MCP.
architectural_planes.role_vs_others: Deterministic, auditable actuator & integration backbone where strict SLA, compliance, and multi-year SIEM coexistence are mandatory.

architectural_planes.plane: 5. Upstream Agentic AppSec, Vulnerability Discovery & Code Remediation Plane
architectural_planes.products: Codename MDASH + GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) Agentic Autofix
architectural_planes.status_nov_2026: MDASH: Expanded Preview (Nov 17, 2026); GHAS Agentic Autofix: GA on GHEC (Oct 15, 2026) & Public Preview on Azure DevOps (Nov 23, 2026)
architectural_planes.key_capabilities: MDASH: 5-stage multi-model agentic harness (Prepare -> Scan [100+ specialized subagents] -> Validate [LSP taint/type + cross-model debate] -> Dedupe -> Prove [dynamic PoC/fuzzing]), repos up to 5 GB, regulated clouds, MAI-Cyber-1.1-Flash & MAI-Cyber-2 (Preview) via Microsoft Foundry, feeds Perception Web App Pen Test Agent. GHAS Agentic Autofix: copilot-swe-agent explores multi-file repo context, reruns CodeQL to verify closure, opens PR (up to 25 alerts/PR in Security Campaigns).
architectural_planes.role_vs_others: MDASH discovers & proves deep/zero-day source-code flaws read-only; GHAS Agentic Autofix + GitHub Copilot generate verified multi-file code fixes in developer workflows.

architectural_planes.plane: 6. AI & Agentic Insider Governance, Identity & Runtime Containment Plane
architectural_planes.products: Microsoft Agent 365 + Microsoft Entra Agent ID + Defender Local Agent Runtime Protection + Purview DLP for Agents
architectural_planes.status_nov_2026: Defender Local Agent Discovery & Runtime Protection on Windows: GA (Nov 2026); 3P Cloud Agent Posture (Bedrock/Vertex/Gemini/Claude) & Dynamic Agent Risk: Preview; Purview Unlabeled Copilot Grounding & Local Agent DLP: Public Preview Jan 2027
architectural_planes.key_capabilities: Discovers 60 local agent types (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenClaw, ChatGPT Desktop) + 3P cloud agents; assigns Entra Agent ID with Conditional Access & task-scoped Dynamic Permissions; blocks malicious instructions in the agent loop on Windows; enforces Purview sensitivity/DLP across prompts and files.
architectural_planes.role_vs_others: Full-stack identity + endpoint OS + data-layer containment ('revoke identity, block runtime loop, enforce data policy'), not just an API gateway cutoff.
